carousels.hook: Google Ads hides your highest-converting clicks in ‘Other searches’
carousels.throughline: Google Ads buries your best-performing clicks in the ‘Other searches’ report, where most advertisers never look.

reel_beats.hook: Google is hiding 30% of your best clicks in one report

body.text: Open the Search Terms report to see what people actually typed.
Click ‘Other searches’—this is where Google buries high-intent clicks.
Sort by conversions to find searches that buy but never show up.
Add them as exact match keywords to stop wasting budget on broad searches.

carousels.caption: Save this ↓ Google Ads charges you for clicks that bounce in under 2 seconds—even if they leave immediately. Turn on this setting to stop paying for bounces and save 15-20% of your budget. Here’s how to fix it. #googleadstips #ppcmanagement #adspend
carousels.hook: Google Ads charges you for clicks that bounce in under 2 seconds
carousels.throughline: Google Ads charges for clicks that bounce in under 2 seconds, but a simple setting can stop this waste.

reel_beats.hook: You’re paying Google for clicks that leave in 2 seconds

body.text: Open campaign settings and click ‘Additional settings.’
Find ‘Exclude low-quality clicks’ and turn it on.
Set the threshold to 2 seconds—this filters out bounces.
Google stops charging for clicks that leave too fast, saving you money.

reel_beats.send_line: Send this to whoever manages your ads
